title: US army plan to detonate bomb-making chemicals has Iowa residents bracing for lead dust cloud
summary_full: Officials recommend that residents in path of expected toxic plume vacate area, and some schools will be closedPlans by the US army to detonate about 5 tons of bomb-making chemicals that have become unusable and might explode if moved have residents in south-east Iowa worried that a cloud of lead dust could cause environmental contamination and health problems.The detonation at the Iowa army ammunition plant is scheduled for Friday, and officials recommend that some residents in nearby Middletown begin vacating the area that morning. If they cannot leave their homes, they should stay inside and keep windows and doors closed. Continue reading...
